R Notebook

Overview

This document compares Relative Sea Level (RSL) estimates and rates from 2 models. Make sure to run these models using RunIGP_For_Differences before you knit this document.

This document produces:

  • RSL estimates
  • RSL differences
  • RSL rates
  • Rate differences

Libraries and Directories

library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

source("R/F_differences.R")

Plots and output files will be in your working directory.
